blocking_invariants: Teaching content never creates or modifies gameplay mechanics, source truth, canonical content, Character rules, Campaign truth or Pack lifecycle truth.
Authentication, entitlement, Campaign membership, role, delegation and field visibility remain separate authority dimensions.
Permission filtering occurs before help search, topic selection, counts, examples, screenshots, tutorial branches, diagnostics, exports, notifications and AI context.

A hidden object, feature, proposal, issue, relationship, participant or state may not leak through counts, disabled options, missing-topic wording, autocomplete, ranking, tutorial prerequisites, diagnostics or examples.
Player teaching may not contain GM-only truth, secret modifiers, unrevealed clues, private motives, unrelated Campaign data or protected source fields.
Local draft, local autosave, submitted command, accepted Event and displayed projection are taught as distinct states; offline state never implies authoritative mutation.
Ambiguous network outcome is taught as status-unknown/recovery-required until authoritative status lookup resolves it; no duplicate user intent is encouraged.
Contextual teaching preserves return context and does not force irreversible progress or trap keyboard, touch or screen-reader users.
Mobile, keyboard, touch, screen-reader, high-zoom, reduced-motion and noncolor teaching convey the same required evidence and decisions.
Generated or AI-assisted teaching may summarize an already-authorized projection but has no authority to widen access, decide, approve, mutate or promote content.
Tutorial-Campaign content is synthetic/noncanonical teaching material unless separately promoted through a governed canonical-content process.
PPIA-13 may point to error/recovery/permission concepts but may not consume PPIA-14 by pretending the complete microcopy library already exists.
The unresolved F024 packet must remain a visible source gap; PPIA-13 may not fabricate missing Pack lifecycle actions or policy.
No application runtime, STAGE-A-A2, internal-alpha release, deployment, tester access, paid service or production credential is activated by PPIA-13 artifacts.
